questions.q: What is wrong: 'NOTICE — Hi friends! We are having a super fun book fair next week, please come all!!!'
questions.a: Nearly everything: first person, exclamation, no org name/date/heading/contact, invitation-tone. A wrong answer listing only 'no date' shows single-fault audits — check skeleton AND register.

questions.q: Which body fits a notice: 'You should come!' or 'Interested students may register with Mrs Das by Friday'?
questions.a: The second — third person, action + deadline + contact. The first performs enthusiasm, which is not what notices do.

questions.q: Where does 'ABC School' go in a notice?
questions.a: At the very top, above NOTICE — the issuing authority leads because authority IS the format. A wrong answer putting it at the bottom shows the signature-block confusion.
